calendar_policy: anchor windows within original UTC phases; retain empty and partial endpoint windows; primary one-step scoring requires two full-duration windows and nonempty target
mechanical_search: reuse declared v2 grid and two refinements independently per resolution; include duration-scaled v2 optimum; radius grid is frozen training-derived geometry
selection: complete development one-step mean primary distance, all seeds; exact ties prefer no adaptation and fewer iterations
adaptation_inputs: current observed count and current prior-observation discrepancy; training-only count and discrepancy reference scales
scenario_horizons: one full window only: 6, 12 or 24 h; no 48-hour output
